title: Quantum eMotion to Acquire Plurilock for C$33.8M ($23.8M USD) to Commercialize Quantum-Safe Cybersecurity Platform - Quantum Computing Report
gist: Quantum eMotion (QNC) agreed to acquire Plurilock (PLUR) for ~C$33.8M at C$0.28/share, a 100% premium to the 20-day VWAP, 30% cash/70% stock, to gain an enterprise customer base and Canada/US/NATO procurement channels for its QRNG entropy hardware.

insights.claim: Quantum eMotion will acquire Plurilock for approximately C$33.8 million, paying C$0.084 cash plus 0.0763 QeM shares per Plurilock share, a total C$0.28 that represents a 100% premium to Plurilock's 20-day VWAP as of September 25, 2026.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: A 100% premium signals QeM paying up for distribution, using its equity as currency.
insights.quote: implying a total consideration of C$0.28 per share—a 100% premium over Plurilock’s 20-day volume-weighted average price (VWAP)
insights.locator: Under the terms of the transaction

insights.claim: The deal is 30% cash funded from QeM's balance sheet and 70% equity, leaving existing QeM holders with ~95.97% and former Plurilock holders ~4.03% of the combined company, with closing targeted for late 2026.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Low dilution for QNC holders; deal risk sits mainly in integration and revenue realization.
insights.locator: Under the terms of the transaction

insights.claim: QeM has extended a C$2.0 million secured bridge facility at 8.5% interest to fund Plurilock's pre-closing operations and integration work.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Bridge financing implies Plurilock needed liquidity before closing — a sign of target's weak standalone position.
insights.locator: Under the terms of the transaction

insights.claim: The article's deal table lists the equity value as ~$24.8M USD while the text cites $23.8M USD, an internal inconsistency in the reported conversion.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Investors should verify the USD figure from the primary disclosure.
insights.locator: Quantum eMotion / Plurilock Acquisition & Platform Overview

insights.claim: The acquisition gives QeM an established enterprise customer base, public-sector procurement vehicles across Canada, the U.S. and NATO, and an immediate sales channel for its QRNG hardware and entropy modules.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: For small-cap quantum security vendors, buying channels may be faster than building them — a pattern to watch for further roll-ups.
insights.quote: an immediate commercial sales and deployment channel for its quantum random number generation (QRNG) hardware and entropy modules
insights.locator: Quantum entropy and hardware security vendor

insights.claim: The combined stack pairs QeM's eCore-Q quantum entropy and FIPS 140-3 modules with Plurilock's AI-driven behavioral risk engines for adaptive access control, dynamic key rotation and automated session termination in defense, healthcare and critical infrastructure.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Positions QNC as an AI-plus-quantum security story aimed at regulated sectors.
insights.locator: The transaction bridges QeM’s quantum hardware

insights.claim: QeM has submitted its eCore-Q QRNG NIST SP 800-90B entropy validation package via Lightship Security, and its SecureKey Module is in FIPS 140-3 Implementation Under Test status.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Certifications are gating items for government sales; completion would be a catalyst.
insights.locator: Quantum eMotion / Plurilock Acquisition & Platform Overview
